ModMetaData.name: Sanguophage Lords
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description:
Adds sanguophage lairs, generated underground complexes reached by an ancient stone stairwell. Each lair belongs to an elder sanguophage, with lesser sanguophages and thralls to defend it, and holds a vault, a gene laboratory and a prison among its many rooms.
With Odyssey, a lair entrance can appear on rocky and ruined landmarks. A rare quest that leads to a lair without Odyssey is planned.
Requires Biotech. Royalty, Ideology, Anomaly and Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage each add a room of their own.
